src: Goodhue County plat book (UMedia, University of Minnesota)

vs-2051786.st: The Dodge County Standard Atlas (cat. 1937) draws a "Depot" on the Chicago Great Western, which runs north-south down the center line of sec. 22 Ashland township, at the south edge of sec. 22 where the east-west road on the 22/27 line crosses. Small lots with houses lie west of the track. This agrees with the pin.
src: Standard Atlas of Dodge County, Minnesota (c. 1937), Ashland twp

vs-2097767.st: The 1901 Washington County plat book shows "Maple Island Sta." as a station only, in the SE part of sec. 17 T31N R20W (May township) on the rail line running NE through secs. 17 and 16. The May Town Hall stood at the south edge of the sec. 16/21 line.
src: Plat book of Washington County, Minnesota (Northwest Publishing, 1901), May twp p. 10
https://umedia.lib.umn.edu/item/p16022coll231:13638

vs-2097769.st: The 1901 Washington County plat book shows Otisville P.O. in fractional sec. 19 T32N R19W (New Scandia township) on the St. Croix bank, river lots 5-8, on the Soo Line ("St. Paul") track, with "Stock Yards" on the track just north. A platted grid of about ten blocks lay just south at the sec. 19/30 line, probably the later Copas townsite. Scandia P.O. was about 2.5 miles west.
src: Plat book of Washington County, Minnesota (Northwest Publishing, 1901), New Scandia twp
https://umedia.lib.umn.edu/item/p16022coll231:13635

vs-2051966.st: The 1914 Winona County atlas prints LAMOILLE in bold at the far NW corner of Richmond township, on the river at the Homer township line (fractional sec. 6), with the railroad along the shore. A second LAMOILLE is printed on the track at the north edge of sec. 17 among small 37-acre lots, probably the station.
src: Winona County atlas (1914), Richmond twp T106N R5W p. 19

vs-2050488.st: A post-1906 Houston County atlas has a Reno village inset at the section corner 25/26/35/36 of Crooked Creek township, on the Milwaukee Road: an engine house, stock yard, and hotel with the post office in a wedge lot at the NE, streets Merrill, Bright and Merkle (lots 1-24), and a school at the west end of Merrill St. The Minnesota Slough loops south, with a landing edge east of the stock yard.
src: Houston County atlas (after 1906), Crooked Creek twp pp. 12-13
